name: 1192-sidebar
ask: #1192: Look at the sidebar on the right. Are the team groups and the player colors easy to read?

name: 1239-minimap
task: Move the map from your off hand into an empty hotbar slot, select it, and look down at it.
ask: #1239: Is the map easy to read, and are the unit dots big enough? The sidebar covers the middle of the map: must the sidebar move or hide while you hold the map?

name: 739-follow
task: Double tap Shift: the camera follows a unit of player 1. Watch for about one minute, then double tap Shift again to come back.
ask: #739: Is the follow camera comfortable (height, shake, how often it changes the unit)? Did the overview at the start show enough of the map?

name: 1087-end
ask: #1087 and #1192: Press T and read the end summary in the chat. Then right click the timeline book and turn a page. Are the summary and the book easy to read? Is the 'Replay ended' title over the chat OK?
